_comment: CREATURE BURN, the per-turn Browbeat second main (MTG_CB_BROWBEAT_M2_RESTRICT, default OFF since 2026-11-21 -- measured not an identity; this fixture pins the =1 gate, env below).

The board is the POST-COMBAT frame of 'attack, then Browbeat': turn 5, a Keldon Champion has attacked (tapped; the opponent 10 -> 7), the land drop is used, six untapped Mountains, hand Browbeat + a Mountain we cannot play (so we HOLD a card), library top three Lightning Bolts.

Main-2 Browbeat: 7 <= 8 while we hold a card (USER policy A: take iff life > 5, or > 8 while holding) -> the opponent DECLINES, we draw the three Bolts and cast them off the three Mountains left: 9 damage, WIN THIS TURN.

So the turn-5 kill exists only if this post-combat main is PLAYED: with =1 the deck plays no every-turn main 2, so the per-turn gate must open here (a Browbeat in hand, castable after combat). With MTG_CB_BROWBEAT_M2_RESTRICT=0 the every-turn main 2 plays it the same way.

Why resume_at main2 and not main1 (2026-11-21): from the MAIN-1 frame of the same turn (opponent at 10, Champion untapped) the full-depth search does NOT find this line on EITHER arm, at d2, d3 or d5 with budget 0 (it commits a T6 line, '[fd] T5 LINE win=6'), although the executor's own main-2 solve does (this fixture). A pre-existing completeness gap of the nested post-combat main after a draw, independent of this lever; reported to the analysis, not fixed here.
